scope: Signed-out public desktop startup in the five-flow pilot only. Other AUTH-01 family variants are deferred, not pilot prerequisites. This child does not authorize sign-in.
deferredVariants: Signed-in startup, startup failure, responsive/theme and other recovery variants outside the selected desktop child
expectation: As a new visitor I immediately understand which app I opened and encounter a coherent, readable, trustworthy welcome experience with an obviously usable Sign in action, without unexpected account content or confusing state.
userGoals: Recognize Watai and reach an honestly usable sign-in entry point without signing in
preconditions: Exact target https://prabinpebam.github.io/watai/; actual deployed resources and no mocked responses
Fresh owned headless Chromium context, no storage state or cookies, no extensions or authenticated identity
Viewport 1280x850, device scale factor 1, locale en-US, default application appearance recorded without assuming a theme
Approved serving artifact and design reference identities, independently validated recorder and semantic runtime, and a fresh bounded execution decision
safety: No Sign in click, identity redirect, provider call, form entry or server mutation
GET and HEAD only to exact declared origins; 80 requests, 15 MiB decoded network, 45-second total deadline
No foreground window, OS pointer action, forced click, fallback selector or runtime-invented capture policy
Unexpected protected content or authentication form stops before screenshot; retain only privacy-approved evidence
cleanup: Drain observers and close only the owned context/browser on every exit
Retain the immutable failure evidence; no retry, user-session modification or data deletion

steps.trigger: Before the sole page.goto, after init-script registration and request guards are active
steps.action: Navigate once to the exact public target and await DOMContentLoaded within the remaining 20-second step deadline
steps.expected: A real signed-out startup reaches the welcome shell or an honestly recorded failure; no authentication or protected data appears
failureModes: Authenticated content in the fresh public context

capture.start: Document-start init script before any application script or action wait
capture.end: Recorded transition to ready, or explicit stop with a drained failure record
fields: old/new values or explicit missing history
capture.overflow: Emit an evidence gap, stop actions, drain within the total deadline; never truncate into a pass
capture.unexpectedSurface: Fixed structural sentinel detects undeclared overlay/frame/form; retain safe context then stop insufficient, without increasing resolution

fields: actual style and ancestor clip geometry
regions.reason: Primary task surface including wrong content and unexpected controls
Loading or ancestor state can hide the welcome surface
Unexpected error or overlay is relevant even outside known heuristic outcomes

steps.trigger: One visible .onboard__title observed; ambiguity or missing visibility reaches stop rather than first-match selection
steps.action: Observe the real heading, logo, subtitle and sole .onboard__actions button without activation; record ready screenshot after privacy eligibility is established
steps.expected: Exactly Welcome to Watai and one accessible Sign in button are visible, readable and operable with actual assets
failureModes: Blank logo or fallback glyph overlap
Hidden, covered, clipped or offscreen action

capture.start: Before checking ready predicates, retaining capture through all waits and failed predicates
capture.end: Transition to inspect or explicit failure stop
channels: geometry/ancestor clipping and center hit test
capture.overflow: Stop insufficient on any text/node/event/byte overflow, frame gap over 250 ms or observer work over 50 ms
capture.unexpectedSurface: Fixed sentinel only; an effect not representable by the declared roots is a capture-design gap and stops the case

regions.reason: User must perceive and operate the actual entry point
An apparently correct descendant can still be hidden by its context
Errors and overlays must not be curated out of semantic evidence

steps.trigger: Before the first real Tab action, with the same declared capture resolution active
steps.action: Press Tab at most eight times, each bounded by min(3 seconds, remaining step time), stopping when the exact Sign in button owns focus; never click it. Observe 1000 monotonic ms of subsequent frames, take focused screenshot, then drain and close
steps.expected: The intended button is keyboard reachable and visibly focused with the real box-shadow ring; no content/focus regression occurs before cleanup
failureModes: Eighth Tab fails to reach the button
Focus stolen or primary content disappears
Insufficient time remains for the complete observation/drain

capture.start: Before each keydown and throughout Playwright action waits
capture.end: After the full 1000-ms observation, required screenshot and final drain; otherwise evidence-insufficient stop
capture.overflow: Stop and preserve incomplete evidence; no sleep, extra keypress, click or later screenshot can repair an omitted interval
capture.unexpectedSurface: Undeclared overlay or focus owner is retained as an anomaly; omitted detail means insufficient, never automatic fallback

regions.reason: Prove the entry point remains coherent and keyboard usable
Preserve dependencies that may steal focus or hide the action
Unexpected intermediate errors remain reviewable after final correction

heuristics.algorithm: Require exactly one welcome h1 at every ready/inspect snapshot; compare text exactly to Welcome to Watai and require positive visible geometry; retain all transient violations
heuristics.pass: Every observed required heading state satisfies the rule
heuristics.fail: Wrong/duplicate/absent/hidden heading in a complete observed region
heuristics.insufficient: Missing region coverage, text, visibility, geometry or temporal interval
negativeCases: Wrong text with true driver outcome

inputs: center hit target and descendant parent IDs
heuristics.algorithm: At every ready/inspect snapshot require one Sign in button, visible/enabled/ancestor-visible, positive bounds fully in viewport, center within clipBounds, and hitTargetId equal to button or a retained descendant
heuristics.pass: All observed required action states satisfy each condition
heuristics.fail: Covered, clipped, offscreen, hidden, wrong-name or disabled action, even if later correct
heuristics.insufficient: Missing computed accessible name, ancestor/clip/hit evidence or scope coverage

inputs: focused screenshot and ring pixel region
heuristics.algorithm: Require real Tab actions in inspect, at most eight; exact button must acquire and retain focus; observed visibleRingPixels must be positive and reference the actual focus screenshot; the approved ring threshold/reference still requires independent binding
heuristics.pass: Reachability and actual ring paint are observed for the full final interval
heuristics.fail: Eighth Tab cannot reach button, focus lost afterward, invisible ring or undeclared action

heuristics.algorithm: Compare every required served asset and resolved font/paint reference with independently approved identities; require nonblank decoded brand paint and no fallback glyph overlap; exact reference values are a remaining preparation blocker
heuristics.pass: All actual resources and paint agree with the approved reference
heuristics.fail: Wrong/missing resource, blank brand or unreadable fallback even with HTTP success
heuristics.insufficient: Approved reference or required bitmap/font/asset observation absent

heuristics.algorithm: Require fresh signed-out context throughout, no protected/form surface, GET/HEAD only to fixed origins, cumulative requests <=80 and decoded bytes <=15728640; any page error is product failure. Independent identity/request scope qualification remains required
heuristics.pass: Every request and observed state satisfies fixed public safety rules
heuristics.fail: Protected content, unauthorized method/origin, page crash or over-budget traffic
heuristics.insufficient: Missing initial-state proof, request stream or sentinel coverage

heuristics.algorithm: Require navigate->ready->inspect once, receiver IDs from1 without gaps and per-document sequences contiguous; capture every action wait; require frames/snapshots/required assets and successful drain; visible frame interval>250ms, overflow or lost history is insufficient. Do not erase reliable product failures
heuristics.pass: All required calibrated channels and intervals are present
heuristics.fail: Keep separately observed product failures regardless of later capture failure
heuristics.insufficient: Any missing phase, snapshot, frame, asset, sequence, drain or capability

semantic.expectation: As a new visitor I immediately understand which app I opened and encounter a coherent, readable, trustworthy welcome experience with an obviously usable Sign in action, without unexpected account content or confusing state.
semantic.contextExhaustion: Deny admission when the declared capture envelope cannot fit the calibrated protocol; never invent compression or omit windows at runtime
semantic.findingContract: Review all original windows and required images, then whole-experience synthesis. Novel categories require no heuristic ID; cite original event:<id>/asset:<id>, observation, expectation, impact, severity and uncertainty. Missing context is insufficient, not no anomalies
